WITH qualifying_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE `U-PRO` = '-' AND RA = '-'
), per_patient AS (
  SELECT l.ID,
         AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt,
         AVG(l.TAT - l.TAT2) AS avg_tat_diff
  FROM Laboratory AS l
  JOIN qualifying_patients AS q ON q.ID = l.ID
  GROUP BY l.ID
)
SELECT AVG(avg_pt) AS average_of_patient_pt_averages,
       AVG(avg_tat_diff) AS average_of_patient_tat_difference_averages
FROM per_patient;
